passage:
There is a wall near the school gate where students can put small notes. It is called the Warm Wall.
The idea began after a student wrote, "I failed my math test. I feel terrible." The next day, someone placed a note below it: "One test is not your whole life." Then more notes appeared.
Now students write many kinds of messages. Some thank a friend. Some say sorry. Some leave jokes. Teachers check the wall every day to remove hurtful words, but most notes are kind.
No one knows who writes each note, and that is part of the beauty. The Warm Wall shows that even quiet people may have something helpful to say.
